mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.3pp over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates supply chain disruption that depresses manufacturing and construction profits, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines and HOUST rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion marked by high consumer credit (RSAFS) and strong housing starts (HOUST) signals economic overheating that triggers profit-taking in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST both exceed 1-year moving averages, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) decline below 0.25% signals aggressive monetary easing that accelerates equity valuation growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS drops below 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month industrial production (INDPRO) decline below 105.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO drops below 105.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in consumer credit (RSAFS) indicates rising household spending that supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS grows, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market contraction that reduces consumer confidence and spending, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
